records.condition: Appointment show rate drops below 55%.

comparison_basis.label: Appointment show rate floor
comparison_basis.source: Duane-supplied starter condition (catalog threshold_provenance); ratified in R2 accepted-facts

industry_reference.reason: SW-032 denominator is "total appointment rows in period", which the committed supporting data proves includes cancelled (4) and rescheduled (7) appointments (23 appointments: 14 confirmed, 13 shown, 6 no-show, 4 cancelled, 7 rescheduled). Foureyes show = appointment shows / appointments SET. The denominators are not the same population, so the mapping is reference-only and NOT used as a variance basis.

evidence_lineage.formula: count(Is Show=Yes) / count(appointment rows)
